# What should you charge to coat this job?

> Free powder coating price calculator for job shops: enter the parts, powder, transfer efficiency, labour, oven batches and setup, and get a price per piece and per square foot with quantity breaks. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/powder-coating-job-price-calculator/)
